title: Utility Services Program Rate Schedule: Block Pricing of Final Electricity Overage
content:
# Block Pricing of the Final Electricity Overage — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

The final electricity overage of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account is priced in blocks according to the account's electricity overage record, which is the electricity overage lines issued on the account fewer than twelve whole months before the billing date.

- **3 or more such lines:** the first 200 kWh of the final electricity overage is priced as measured and the rest at 1.20 times.
- **At least 1 but fewer than 3:** the whole final electricity overage is priced at 1.10 times.
- **None:** the final electricity overage is priced as measured.

The priced electricity overage is rounded to 3 decimals and is the quantity the charge is priced on; the line records the final electricity overage itself as its usage.

## Sample pricing (hypothetical overages)

| Final electricity overage | 3 or more lines | 1 or 2 lines | none |
|---|---|---|---|
| 170.000 kWh | 170.000 | 187.000 | 170.000 |
| 350.000 kWh | 200 plus 180.000 (150.000 at 1.20) is 380.000 | 385.000 | 350.000 |
